description: Moments where something happening in the market gives the company a legitimate reason to say something. Tracks the idea from signal through draft to published, so the same news isn't written up twice and good angles don't evaporate.

columns.name: signal_id
columns.note: Links to 03-Market/signals. Blank if the idea came from elsewhere.

columns.name: headline
columns.note: What happened, in the world's words not ours

columns.name: relevance_why
columns.note: REQUIRED. Why this company specifically has standing to comment. If the honest answer is 'we sell adjacent software', there's no piece here — commentary without standing reads as hijacking.

columns.name: matched_icp
columns.note: Which segment or persona would care

columns.name: suggested_angles
columns.note: Two or three distinct takes, not one idea reworded

columns.name: channel
columns.note: LinkedIn, X, company blog — per the user's configured preference

columns.name: related_account
columns.note: Set when the piece is aimed at a specific account rather than the market

columns.name: related_id
columns.note: LEAD-/OPP-/CUST- id, when this is outreach rather than broadcast

columns.name: perishability
columns.note: How long the news stays fresh. A breach comment written a fortnight late is worse than silence.

columns.name: declined_reason
columns.note: Why it was passed on. Prevents the same idea resurfacing every sweep.
